title: Coleman Octagon 8 Tent — 8 Persons, Orange
short_description: Free-standing octagon tent for 8 people by Coleman. According to the Amazon listing it is waterproof with WeatherTec, with 2 doors, 4 windows and UV Guard.
long_description: The Coleman Octagon 8 is an octagonal, free-standing tent for 8 people. According to the Amazon listing it is waterproof (WeatherTec) and equipped with UV Guard. It has one room, 2 doors and 4 windows. The outer and inner tent are made of polyester, the floor of polyethylene and the poles of an alloy steel. According to Amazon it is designed for spring and summer. The variant shown here is the orange version.
features: Waterproof according to the Amazon listing (WeatherTec)
buying_angle: Useful for camping with several people when a free-standing tent for up to 8 people is needed.
